CustomField.formula: CASE( Name , 'Central GST',(( EYI_Charged_Amount__c * 100)/ EYI_Quote__r.EYI_Agreement_Value__c )/ 100, 'State GST',(( EYI_Charged_Amount__c * 100)/ EYI_Quote__r.EYI_Agreement_Value__c )/ 100, 'Stamp Duty', IF( EYI_Quote__r.EYI_Agreement_Value__c > 0, ( EYI_Quote__r.Stamp_Duty__c / EYI_Quote__r.EYI_Agreement_Value__c), 0 ) , CASE( EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_Charge_Calculated_As__c , 'Percentage of Agreement Value', IF( EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_Global_Charges__r.Name != 'Registration Charges',EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_Charge_Percentage__c, VALUE('')), VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(TEXT(EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_GST_Percentage__c), "GST-", ""))/100) )
CustomField.label: Tax %
